subject: english
question:
Identify the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.

Harry’s behaviour was very __blunt__ during his school days
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"blunt"** means straightforward and unceremoniously frank, often to the point of being rudely abrupt. (स्पष्टवादी)

 
 
• **Example: **His** blunt **remarks during the meeting surprised everyone.
 
 
 
• **"Polite" **refers to showing good manners towards others, being respectful and considerate. (विनम्र)
 
 
• **Example: **She was very** polite** and greeted everyone with a warm smile.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'blunt' **is **'polite'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Excited **(उत्साहित): Feeling or showing happiness and enthusiasm.

 
 
• **Example:** The children were excited about going to the amusement park.
 
 
 
• **Curious **(जिज्ञासु): Eager to know or learn something.
 
 
• **Example: **She was curious about the new student who joined their class.
 
 
 
• **Dull** (मंद): Lacking interest or excitement; boring.
 
 
• **Example:** The lecture was so dull that several students fell asleep.
 
 

45:Ta0f,

The correct answer is: **Option 1.**
